audit.whatIsWrong: Content and full read Graves/Skill/Warwick/Warwick/Graves/Warwick/Warwick; the packet chart reads Skill/Graves/Graves/Graves/Graves/Graves/Skill. The page hands Warwick levels 3-5 and the first item while its own whys[3] says 'you out-stat him in any extended all-in' and whys[5] says your first-item spike out-paces him, and late says 'You spike hardest on first item'. The chart contradicted the prose sitting directly beneath it, in a 54.55% lane.
audit.why: This is a lane Graves wins by forcing all-ins from 2 through first item. The chart was telling him to concede exactly that stretch.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to the packet chart with ratings 5/7/7/7/7/7/5.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] calls level 1 'Warwick's strongest point' on the basis of a misread passive, and the level-6 spike is described as a Graves window because R supposedly knocks him off you.
audit.why: Eternal Hunger keys off Warwick's own health, so it is not a level-1 spike at all — it is a low-health spike that arrives whenever you fail to finish him. Level 6 is a stand-off, not a Graves spike: Infinite Duress is 110s at rank 1 and Primal Howl adds a 1-second fear.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] reframed around Blood Hunt marking you under 50%; spikes[2] reframed as the stand-off it is, with both real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The central error: the page says four times that Warwick's passive 'heals hardest off your low HP' and tells you to 'burst him below his heal threshold'. Riot's Eternal Hunger text is the opposite — it heals when WARWICK is below 50% health and triples below 25%. Chipping him low turns his sustain on, it does not turn it off. The ability that keys off YOUR health is Blood Hunt (W), which senses enemies under 50% and frenzies under 25%. Also: Primal Howl is never mentioned anywhere on the page despite being 2.5s of damage reduction ending in a 1-second flee — the single ability most likely to break a Graves all-in. Plus the Graves-wide boilerplate errors: 'E charge/charges' (Quickdraw has none, it is one dash on 16/15/14/13/12s refreshed by landing autos), 'Smoke Screen to blind his autos' (it reduces sight range and slows on impact), and 'fire R at a wall to escape' / 'R knocks him off' (Collateral Damage has no displacement in its text).
audit.why: 'Burst him below his heal threshold' is advice that actively loses the fight — it walks the player into the exact health bracket where Eternal Hunger triples and Blood Hunt has already marked him.
audit.corrected: Passive re-attributed to Warwick's own health, Blood Hunt named as the ability that reads yours, Primal Howl's fear added to mid and spikes[2], and the three boilerplate errors removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d says Warwick wasting his ult is a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is 110/90/70s. Fifteen seconds understates the window by seven times and makes the player rush a commit he could take at leisure.
Anti-heal is already flagged in itemization, correctly — Eternal Hunger, Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress all heal him.

edits.before: Level 1 is his — one ability, no E charge, short range, and his passive heals hardest off your low HP, so don't shove into a brainless auto-trade and bleed. The lane flips at 2-3 when your E-Q combo and True Grit armor come online. Quickdraw in, drop W Smoke Screen on him to blind his autos, and dump the point-blank 4-shell spread before he can drain it back. His sustain only matters in long fights — keep trades short and burst-shaped so his passive never catches up.
edits.after: Level 1 is a stand-off — one ability, no Quickdraw, short range, and Eternal Hunger switches on the moment he drops under 50%, so a slow auto-trade only feeds his sustain. The lane flips at 2-3 when your E-Q combo and True Grit armor come online. Quickdraw in, drop Smoke Screen on him so he loses sight of you, and dump the point-blank 4-shell spread before he can drain it back. Keep trades short and burst-shaped so his passive never catches up.

edits.before: This is your window. With E charges refreshing off autos and True Grit compounding armor, you out-stat him in any extended melee scrap, and your Q+point-blank shells chunk faster than his Q dash-heal restores. At 6 his R suppress is the only thing that scares you — bait it or hold E to dash clear, then Collateral Damage knocks him off and bursts him below his heal threshold. Force every all-in here while Infinite Duress is his lone equalizer.
edits.after: This is your window. With Quickdraw refreshing off your autos and True Grit compounding armor, you out-stat him in any melee scrap, and Q plus point-blank shells chunk faster than Jaws of the Beast restores. At 6 two things scare you: Infinite Duress, a 1.5-second suppress on 110s, and Primal Howl, 2.5s of damage reduction that ends in a 1-second fear. Force every all-in while both are down.

notes: The passive inversion is the most damaging error found in this champion so far: the page told the player to burst Warwick low, which is precisely the state where Eternal Hunger triples. Primal Howl was absent from the entire page and is now named in mid and spikes[2]. The 'E charges', 'Smoke Screen blinds' and 'R knockback' errors continue to appear on every Graves matchup — they are template-level, not per-matchup.
